title: Naringenin restores osteogenic differentiation in TNF-alpha-Treated bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells by targeting AKR1B1.
authors: He, Bin; He, Feng; Li, Huimin; Huang, Leyi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究柚皮素通过靶向AKR1B1恢复TNF-α处理骨髓间充质干细胞的成骨分化，核心是炎症与氧化应激通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，仅分子对接为辅助，与本课题无关。
abstract: In chronic inflammatory microenvironments, TNF-alpha disrupts bone remodeling by suppressing osteogenic differentiation in human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells (hBMSCs), while conventional TNF-alpha inhibitors lack osteoprotective effects. This study reveals that naringenin counteracts TNF-alpha-induced osteogenic suppression by potentially targeting AKR1B1 to restore redox balance and inhibit NF-kappaB-mediated inflammation. In vitro experiments demonstrated that naringenin restored osteogenic capacity in TNF-alpha-treated hBMSCs, enhancing ALP activity, mineralization, and expression of RUNX2/OCN while reducing IL-6/IL-1beta levels. Mechanistically, naringenin scavenged free radicals, elevated SOD/CAT activity, and attenuated TNF-alpha-driven ROS accumulation. Bioinformatics analysis identified TNF-alpha-activated NF-kappaB signaling and upregulation of the oxidative stress enzyme AKR1B1, with molecular docking confirming strong binding between naringenin and AKR1B1. This study pioneers AKR1B1 as a novel therapeutic target for inflammatory bone loss, demonstrating naringenin's synergistic "antioxidant-anti-inflammatory-pro-osteogenic" effects. These findings provide a theoretical foundation for phytochemical applications in orthopedic therapies and highlight potential clinical translation strategies.
abstract_zh: 在慢性炎症微环境中，TNF-alpha通过抑制人骨髓间充质干细胞（hBMSCs）的成骨分化来破坏骨重塑，而传统的TNF-alpha抑制剂缺乏骨保护作用。本研究揭示，柚皮素通过潜在靶向AKR1B1恢复氧化还原平衡并抑制NF-kappaB介导的炎症，从而对抗TNF-alpha诱导的成骨抑制。体外实验表明，柚皮素恢复了TNF-alpha处理的hBMSCs的成骨能力，增强了ALP活性、矿化以及RUNX2/OCN的表达，同时降低了IL-6/IL-1beta水平。机制上，柚皮素清除自由基，提高SOD/CAT活性，并减弱TNF-alpha驱动的ROS积累。生物信息学分析鉴定了TNF-alpha激活的NF-kappaB信号通路及氧化应激酶AKR1B1的上调，分子对接证实柚皮素与AKR1B1之间存在强结合。本研究开创性地将AKR1B1作为炎症性骨丢失的新型治疗靶点，展示了柚皮素协同的“抗氧化-抗炎-促成骨”效应。这些发现为植物化学物质在骨科治疗中的应用提供了理论基础，并强调了潜在的临床转化策略。
